rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=7, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=3.5, img_sy=3.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-15: ONE knob changed vs the iter-14 base (image-domain bilateral WINDOW SIZE img_kernel 5->7); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_14.json (img_sx/img_sy=3.5, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 LOOSE demo-correct, proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, proj_sx/sy=1.0/2.0, proj_sr=0.02, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 -> identical seed=42 val split, directly comparable to iter-14 SSIM 0.8035 / hr 0.3320 / PSNR 20.17). UNLOCK THE BINDING CONSTRAINT. Read iter-13->14 BY SSIM (the surface the spatial lever moves; hr stays pinned at the ~0.332 64-view-FBP noise-floor ceiling): the image-domain SPATIAL sigma img_sx/img_sy is monotone-climbing -- 1.5->2.5->3.5 gave SSIM 0.7796->0.7940->0.8035 (+0.0144 then +0.0095, still climbing but the gain is shrinking). FAILURE MODE (pre-registered in iter-14): img_kernel is pinned at 5, so the discrete bilateral WINDOW is only +/-2 px. At img_sx=3.5 the Gaussian spatial weight is near-FLAT across that tiny 5-px window -- the sigma is requesting a wider averaging support than the window can physically reach, so the kernel=5 window (NOT the sigma) is now the BINDING CONSTRAINT and further sigma widening will saturate. The unlock is to widen the WINDOW itself. img_sx/img_sy (continuous spatial sigma) and img_kernel (discrete window SIZE) are distinct axes; sigma was tuned first (the finer lever inside the fixed window), and now that it has reached the window edge, img_kernel is the live follow-on. HYPOTHESIS (img-kernel): widening img_kernel 5->7 enlarges the per-BF window from +/-2 px to +/-3 px so the img_sx=3.5 spatial Gaussian can actually average over the larger neighborhood it is requesting -> lifts SSIM past iter-14 0.8035 on the SAME seed=42 split (watch whether hr finally moves off ~0.332 too, or stays pinned at the 64-view-FBP noise-floor ceiling -- if SSIM rises but hr stays flat, the kernel/sigma axis is an SSIM-only structural-similarity lever bounded by the same FBP hr ceiling; if SSIM ALSO saturates, the image-domain spatial denoising is fully exhausted and the ~0.80 SSIM / ~0.33 hr ceiling is the substrate bound). Chose img_kernel 5->7 (the pre-registered iter-15 step -- the window-size follow-on once the spatial sigma reached the window edge) over (a) pushing img_sx/img_sy 3.5->4.5 (sigma is now window-capped -- further widening inside the same 5-px window cannot reach the wider support, the diagnosis this iter directly tests), (b) proj_sr/proj_kernel/proj_n_bf (whole proj domain confirmed flat at iter-11/12 -- symmetry trap, wasted), (c) img_sr (exhausted + substrate-confirmed WRONG-direction -- tightening to 0.0005 collapsed hr 0.3335->0.1998 at iter-4 -- FORBIDDEN, stays LOOSE 0.02), (d) img_n_bf/n_iter/pretrain_epochs/seed/val_n (all DEAD FLAT / variance-only, exhausted), (e) grad_clip (mandatory overflow guard at 1.0, not a quality lever). Held fixed at iter-14 values: img_sx=3.5/img_sy=3.5, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 (LOOSE, demo-correct), proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, proj_sr=0.02, proj_sx=1.0/proj_sy=2.0, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. Wall: iter-14 ran 331 s; a 7-px image-BF window is modestly slower per step than a 5-px window (the image-domain conv is a small fraction of the 128-view FBP+proj per-step cost) -- n_iter/val_n kept at iter-14 values, so wall stays comfortably under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard (under the 15-min budget). PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; warm_start STAYS ON; do NOT revert to amortized; do NOT tighten img_sr.
